scope: Citation and quantity checks from primary publisher and institutional metadata. No original PDF, figure digitization, observation array or model field acquired or processed.

leads.title: Structure and transport of the East African Coastal Current
leads.evidence_kind: Original EACC observational study identified; full original not acquired
leads.why_needed: Check actual shoreward and offshore support, section dates, vertical convention and velocity-boundary criterion behind later cross-shore descriptions.
leads.do_not_infer: An offshore transport-integration limit does not by itself supply two observed current boundaries.

leads.title: Volume transport and property distributions of the Mozambique Channel
leads.evidence_kind: Primary author/institutional bibliography and abstract; not original methods or figures
leads.quantity_check: The abstract's western 200 km statement concerns oxygen-property distributions in the Mozambique Channel. That statement alone is not an EACC velocity width.
leads.followup_reason: Later circulation prose cites this paper for an EACC scale. The original may discuss other quantities elsewhere; inspect it before confirming or rejecting that citation.

leads.title: Interannual Variability of the East African Coastal Current Associated with El Niño–Southern Oscillation
leads.evidence_kind: Indexed publisher prose; direct reader returned HTTP403
leads.indexed_number_context: The introduction calls the EACC about 160–200 km wide and separately describes core position and an offshore zero-velocity boundary, citing earlier literature.
leads.method_lead: Indexed methods describe a June maximum-surface-meridional-velocity axis from OFES. A model axis is not automatically a full-width diagnosis or observed current length.
leads.do_not_infer: Restated historical numbers are not independent observations or sampled annual extrema; verify original methods and figures before numerical admission.

next_action: Prioritize an accessible original observational methods/figure review. Preserve existing typed offshore context and do not promote indexed prose into a measured or annual width.
